title: The Relic Procession
text: The Court parades a saint's withered hand through the streets in a cage of gold, with swinging censers and chanting. Everyone must kneel as it passes, and the guards watch for anyone who does not. The fingers twitch as it goes by.

options.label: Kneel as it passes; the guards are watching.

outcomes.text: The hand blesses you after a fashion. One finger points.

options.label: The deftest hands steal the saint's hand from its golden cage.

outcomes.text: It is a true relic. It twitches in the sack.
The whole procession turns, censers swinging.

options.label: The devout one asks to touch it and begs its healing.

outcomes.text: It is warm. Where it touches, the hurt closes.
